tables.title:
PART II – HARBOUR PHASE
SECTION - A DOCUMENTATION INSPECTION

cells.value:
Check individual’s signatures for completion of actions as per check list.
Check correctness of data entered.

Check all parameters in prescribed exploitation ranges.
Check legibility/ overwriting.
Ensure signature by relevant person.
Limiting parameters sheet to be pasted in respective running log.

Check entries of running hours.
Check entries of major defects.
Check monthly CBPM reading entered in service log.
Ensure routines are undertaken as per MAINTOPs and relevant entries are made and counter signed at appropriate level.
Ensure routines are undertaken as per MAINTOPs and relevant entries are made and counter signed at appropriate level.
State of SV mounts for cracks/bulge & application of Nicol Lacquer
Absence of accumulated fuel / oil inside the GT casing
Check instrumentation and gauges for satisfactory working.
Intactness of rubber coaming on GT casing
GT casing doors and their locking
Check Pressure in GT fire fighting bottles( 100- 110 kgf/cm²). Bottles should not be rusted.
Rubber is not torn, flaking or hard. Baffles are intact and corrosion free.
Wire mesh is clean. Mesh and guards are corrosion free and intact.
Clean and free from rust marks & foreign material.
Drain line is clear and no water accumulation in tray.
Lagging work is intact and all perforated sheets are secured properly with tag welding of securing nuts
Check for correct functioning of locking arrangement. Check condition of rubber coaming.
Check presence of water in the hydraulic seal. Fill hydraulic seal with fresh water
Check the perforated sheet of air supply duct.

Check condition of exhaust duct for securing arrangement and rust marks & survey.
Check for carbon soot formation and clear if required.
Check remote/ manual operation of ventilation blower in ASP
Check all interconnecting valves are operational.
Check system pipes are secured properly.
Air pressure in the cylinders of the air systems
Check the air pressure in the cylinders of the air systems, which shall be at least 150 kgf/cm²
Check valves and fittings for freedom of movement.
Check fuel level in gravity tank, should not be below 3/4 level.

Ensure pressure gauges before and after filters are in working condition.
Check filter difference across filters, should be less than 2.0 & 1.5 Kgf/cm² for CT-500 & ΦHT filters respectively.
Check filter body for corrosion and leakages.
Check the date of last replacement, both filters elements to be renewed six monthly.
Fine fuel filter, starting fuel igniter , flow restrictors
Check filter difference across filter. should be less than 1.5 Kgf/cm² Check filter body for corrosion and leakages.
Check for presence of metal particles.

Tank to be cleaned as per MAINTOPs and suitable entries to be made respective log book.
Tank level gauges to be in good working conditions.
Start the fuel booster pump; check the fuel pressure, which should be 1.8 to 3.0 kgf/cm²
Fuel pressure gauge lines should be of SS.
Inspection of starting throttle valve of starting system.
Physical inspection of dump valve with drain line disconnected during GT starting.

Check oil level in circulating tanks. Should be in CGT 100-120 ltr, BGT 100-120 ltr, CRG 140-160 ltr, BRG 220-240 ltr.Check oil level in circulating tanks, normal amount of oil should be in GTs 250-300 kg, RG 3000-4500 Kg
Check for leakages, corrosion and securing clamps.
Check availability of lab equipment and chemicals of salinity checks.
Check operation of lub oil pump units of GT & RG systems.
Check level, tank should be clear.
Check gauge glass is clean and level is visible.
Last change date, should be checked every quarterly & to be renewed if deteriorated more than 50%, Renewed every six monthly.
Check valves and fittings for freedom of movement.
Regular insulation checks as per OI and make entries in running logs.
Earthing checks of the control system. Electrical hygiene of units/ cables/ sensors.
Functional Checks of all push buttons/ switches/ indications.
Auto & Manual operation of all pumps & motors Both from local and remote positions.
Cold & Hot checks of all safety cut outs.
Clutching/ declutching of in cold condition.
Electric starter should be free from rust and dust. Check the electrical connection of starter.
Check of control connection of connection boxes.
Check the condition of Reversing Mechanism control wire
Carry out visual inspection of electrical equipment of engines. Remove corrosion, moisture, dirt and oil.
Check insulation resistance of the AC and DC circuits.
Compare the measured values of the current intensity with the certificate date of barring gear.
Press the PTR monitoring button for 10 sec. PTR on, fault and running signals shall appear. Release the button and the signal shall disappear.
Check the engine reverse control system.
Check impossibility of power build up above 0.5N at stop Prop mode
Check impossibility of power build up above 0.1N at disengage condition
Stop cock Emergency drain vv open
Stop cock Emergency drain vv open
